reference.title: Dumbbell Lying Supine Curl
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Upper Arms, equipment Dumbbell, Bench, exercise type Strength
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

breathing.pattern: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
breathing.cadence: About 1.2 s up, short squeeze, about 2.5 s down, brief pause at the bottom

prescription.progression: Load is user-chosen: pick a dumbbell you can curl for the target reps with 1-3 reps in reserve (RIR 1-3, clinical opinion); add reps, then weight. Start light: the stretched start makes the weight feel heavier (clinical opinion).

cues.text: Lie on your back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor. Let the arms hang down below the bench, slightly out to the sides, palms up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up toward the shoulders; the upper arms stay where they hang.
Squeeze at the top; shoulders stay on the bench.
Breathe in and lower slowly until the arms are straight again.
Pause briefly in the stretch, then repeat.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the elbows up toward the ceiling
mistakes.fix: Keep the upper arms hanging below the bench; only the forearms move.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the back off the bench
mistakes.fix: Keep the hips and shoulders on the pad, feet planted.
Lower slowly and pause at straight arms.

mistakes.mistake: Going too heavy for the stretched position
mistakes.fix: Use a lighter dumbbell than for a standing curl.

kinematics.norm: Full range: mean elbow range was about 117-123 degrees across barbell, EZ-bar and alternating dumbbell curls (Marcolin 2018)

kinematics.measure: Forearm rotation (wrist pron channel, 0 = palm up/forward, 90 = thumb up)
kinematics.norm: The supinated grip gave the highest biceps activity in the lifting phase; neutral grips shift work toward the brachioradialis (Coratella 2023)

kinematics.measure: Upper arm from the trunk line (sagittal)
kinematics.norm: Upper arms hang below the bench line (shoulder extended past the trunk), similar to the incline curl but further (clinical opinion); Attarieh 2025 trained the biceps with the shoulder extended about 50 degrees
Controlled, about 1 s up and 2-3 s down (clinical opinion); biceps activity was lower while lowering than lifting at the same load (Oliveira 2009)

kinematics.measure: Back on the bench (skinned mesh gap)
kinematics.norm: Shoulders, back and hips on the pad, feet flat (clinical opinion)

cautions: Elbow or shoulder pain: lighten the dumbbell and shorten the range; stop if pain is sharp (clinical opinion).
Keep the wrists straight (in line with the forearm); a bent-back wrist under load strains the forearm (clinical opinion).
Pick the dumbbells up and set them down with a straight back and bent knees.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Front-of-shoulder pain in the hanging position: use the incline curl instead (clinical opinion).
progressions: Slower lowering with a 1 s pause in the stretch.

muscleNotes.biceps_r: Main elbow flexor; lying on the bench with the arms hanging below it puts the shoulder in extension, which stretches the biceps long head at the start. Extended-shoulder and flexed-shoulder curls built the biceps similarly over 10 weeks (Attarieh 2025).
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Main elbow flexor; lying on the bench with the arms hanging below it puts the shoulder in extension, which stretches the biceps long head at the start. Extended-shoulder and flexed-shoulder curls built the biceps similarly over 10 weeks (Attarieh 2025).
muscleNotes.forearm_extensors_r: Brachioradialis (mapped to the forearm extensor region) assists elbow flexion, most with the forearm near neutral.
muscleNotes.forearm_extensors_l: Brachioradialis (mapped to the forearm extensor region) assists elbow flexion, most with the forearm near neutral.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Wrist and finger flexors hold the handle and keep the wrist straight.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Wrist and finger flexors hold the handle and keep the wrist straight.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Holds the upper arm still in the stretched position below the bench.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Holds the upper arm still in the stretched position below the bench.
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk still so the hips do not swing the weight up.
muscleNotes.pec_r: Steadies the arm in the hanging position with the front of the shoulder stretched.
muscleNotes.pec_l: Steadies the arm in the hanging position with the front of the shoulder stretched.
